task_title: AI runner eager maintenance tick — claim rewards and equip bag items anywhere

plan_review.notes: Plan reviewed: (1) safe-room bypass — `force:true` must be used on `equipFromBag` in the eager path so equipping works outside safe rooms, matching the pattern already established in `auto-progression.ts` and `merchant-weapon-intent.ts`. Resolved by adding `{force:true}` to `runBagOnlyEquipmentLoop`. (2) Test signal — tests setting `playerInSafeRoom=true` would pass even without `force:true`, masking the real fix. Resolved by changing equipment test cases to use `playerInSafeRoom=false` which proves `force:true` is the mechanism.

rounds.notes: Two medium findings: (1) Missing bag-empty early-exit guard in `runBagOnlyEquipmentLoop` — without it, `buildEquipmentCandidates` (which calls `getQuartermasterOfferViews`) fires every tick on Floor 2 even when bag is empty, wasting work. Fixed by adding a `generatedEquipment.length === 0` guard before the loop. (2) Missing test for the deferred-retry path — if the two retry calls in step 4 of `runEagerMaintenanceTick` were removed, all 8 tests would still pass. Fixed by adding a 9th test: bag-at-capacity with 1 item → achievement deferred → loop equips the item (freeing capacity) → retry claims the achievement.
